visualCharacteristics.purpose: Lead-generation contact form (Solicita información) rendered from authored field rows; no external submission unless an endpoint is authored
visualCharacteristics.summary: Lead-generation contact form (Solicita información) rendered from authored field rows; no external submission unless an endpoint is authored

contentPattern.structure: One row per field: Label (append * for required) | Type (text, email, tel, number, date, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, consent, hidden, heading, info, submit, success, action) | Options (select/radio list) or placeholder | Required (yes). Row type "action" holds the POST endpoint link; "success" holds the thank-you message. Alternatively a single-cell row linking a .json sheet (Name, Label, Type, Options, Mandatory, Placeholder)

reuseGuidance: Default lead form. Without an action row, submissions are validated and acknowledged locally and never sent anywhere.
